svg.title: Llama trait profiles in descending PC1 order

g.text: 15 of 275 personas; highest first. Height = within-model, within-trait percentile (0-100).
15 of 240 mapped traits; editorial groups, not a valence scale or fitted factors.
Same-space activation cosines; percentiles are within-model ranks. Curves are not probability densities.
